triggerCases.prompt: Audit this new account-deletion endpoint for authorization and privacy risks.
Review this button-label change for clarity and visual consistency.
Review this pull request across authorization security, migration compatibility, and test quality.

outputCases.prompt: Perform a read-only security review of this account endpoint.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A read-only security review that distinguishes a reachable authorization failure from unsupported threat-model speculation.
assertions: The finding identifies the request boundary, missing control, and affected account data.
The review does not expose or request credentials.
Unspecified deployment protections remain verification gaps.

outputCases.prompt: Review this endpoint for security and return the findings in chat only. Do not create a review artifact or post anything.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A read-only security review returned in chat without a local artifact or GitHub write.
assertions: The workflow returns the security findings directly in chat.
The workflow does not create or open a local review document.
The workflow does not modify source or post to GitHub.
